source: POC seed (APPROXIMATE). EPO closure days for 2025, approximated from the public holidays at the EPO's main filing locations (Munich / The Hague). The EPO publishes its own annual list of days on which its filing offices are not open; production must load that authoritative list (it differs from any single country's public-holiday set and changes year to year). Hand-curated, no clean machine-readable upstream — see scripts/fetch_holidays.py EP note.
